name: Stage 17: Harsjöhult to Finnsjön
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 17, Harsjöhult to Finnsjön.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Harsjöhult has limited parking/access at the public-road end and connects to stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop; do not treat it as a service node.

Finnsjön is the real overnight node with shelter, fireplace/grill context, dry toilet, trash-bin context, lake access, swimming, and tenting on the shelter point, but several amenities are separated around the point rather than all beside the shelter.

Finnsjön should not be treated as a normal pickup/dropoff point: official Sörmlandsleden warns that the Kalkbro-Finnsjön forest road is gated/blocked to motor traffic and that the barrier may be missing from some Lantmäteriet-based maps. The closest OSM gate context belongs to Stage 18 access and should be shown as a car-access warning, not as a Stage 17 facility.
No bus or train stop is within 2 km of Stage 17 itself; practical public-transport access is via Åkers Styckebruk and the Stage 16:1 connector.
waterSources: No potable tap was verified on stage 17. The best nearby refill is the Harsjöhult cold spring about 50-60 m from the start on the stage-16/16:1 side; treat/filter it as natural water and do not assume tested quality.
Trullsjön and Finnsjön are natural lake water only. Trullsjön is described as brown-water; Finnsjön may look clear but should still be treated.
AllTrails-style 'water' at Finnsjön should be interpreted as lake access, not a potable tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan/OSM also present it as 6 km, Naturkartan GPX and OSM relation 3870287 measure about 5.859 km, Äventyrligare lists 5.84 km, Gaia about 5.95 km, and AllTrails about 6.3 km with about 217 m ascent and a 1.5-2 hour moving-time estimate.

Short but remote forest/myr stage with sparse pine forest, rock slabs, old pasture/woodland, Abborrsjön/Abborrmossen views, Trullsjön, Korsmossen/Pansarmossen/Långmossen, charcoal remains, about 600 m of boardwalks, and final lakeside walking along Finnsjön. After the first roughly 150 m from Harsjöhult there are no normal service buildings or roads until Finnsjön context.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Recent 2025 official comments say fallen trees were cleared by mid-May and the route was well maintained and easy to follow by late September.

OSM relation 3870287 and Naturkartan GPX match closely and are usable, but route rendering should graph-orient from Harsjöhult node 2926356244 to Finnsjön information-map node 2949013106. Way 291430575 and way 291430579 are stored opposite the useful Harsjöhult-to-Finnsjön direction.

Expect roughly 600 m of boardwalks/spångar around Trullsjön, Korsmossen, Pansarmossen, Långmossen, and the Finnsjön shore; wet, icy, spring high-water, and remaining April ice can make boardwalks, beam bridges, and drainage-stream crossings slippery or awkward. Stay on trail and boardwalks through mires to protect vegetation.

Official suitable tent options are Trullsjön, the kolbotten about 100 m north of Långmossen, and the point by Finnsjön shelter. Finnsjön point has the strongest hiker-confirmed tent confidence, Trullsjön is good but can be stony, and the Långmossen kolbotten is official but lacks recent tent-comfort reports. Harsjöhult tenting belongs to adjacent 16:1 context rather than Stage 17's official tent-place list.
Do not add the old Lantmäteriet-map shelter east of Harsjön; Sörmlandsleden explicitly warns that it does not exist.

No source confirmed supplied firewood at Finnsjön. Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance says shelters have fireplace/grill context, but use should be treated as shared first-come shelter use without guaranteed firewood, and fire bans/local signs override any fireplace context.
A 2024 overnight report described rodent/gnawing damage at Finnsjön shelter; store food and scented items securely rather than leaving them in open shelter gear.

General Swedish dog rules still matter here: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed, and leash control is usually the practical default on narrow trails and in reserve context.
Fishing is not included in allemansrätten; do not present fishing in Trullsjön or Finnsjön as allowed unless a permit/right-holder rule is verified.

Exclude false-positive facility imports: Grillplatser/Finnsjön Vindskydd results found in Mölndal are not this Stage 17 Finnsjön, and off-route Magsjöberget/Porsudden context belongs mostly to Stage 18 access rather than this stage.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult parking and stage junction
facilities.description: Limited parking/access by public road for stage 17, stage 16, stage 16:1, and Gallsjömossen. Länsstyrelsen describes it as Gallsjömossen reserve parking about 500 m from the reserve; check local signs. After roughly 150 m, the stage becomes remote forest/wetland with no normal services until Finnsjön context.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult access point.

facilities.name: Nearby Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Nearby cold spring, technically on the stage-16/16:1 side about 50-60 m from the stage-17 start. Treat/filter and do not assume tested quality.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Adjacent connector text describes Harsjöhult as suitable for tenting; useful before or after stage 17, but not one of the official Stage 17 tent places. Follow local signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Berget north of Abborrsjön viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate route-derived viewpoint/rest area on the hill north of Abborrsjön with views over Abborrsjön and Abborrmossen, about 1 km from Harsjöhult.

facilities.name: Finntäppan side-trail junction
facilities.description: Approximate sign/spur-junction context for the old Finn settlement/croft traces; official text describes a 200 m side path, but the exact destination pin is unverified.

facilities.name: Trullsjön rest and lake access
facilities.description: Rest/lunch context by brown-water Trullsjön. Official text lists a small bathing jetty; older reports said ice had damaged it, later Sörmlandsleden newsletter material reported repair with a simple ladder/cleared bottom, and a 2024 hiker report describes a picnic table, simple jetty, and fire ring. Treat any fire ring as local context rather than a verified official fireplace marker. Lake water only.

facilities.name: Trullsjön tent area
facilities.description: Officially listed suitable tent place by Trullsjön. Hiker reports describe it as pleasant but sometimes stony for tents; follow local signs and use low-impact camping.

facilities.name: Trullsjön natural water
facilities.description: Brown-water lake source only; filter/boil/treat and avoid washing/toilet needs near the shore.

facilities.name: Korsmossen / Pansarmossen boardwalks
facilities.description: Approximate long boardwalk/wetland zone, part of the stage's roughly 600 m of spång. Boardwalks and beam bridges can be slippery or icy, and mire drainage can be high after rain or spring melt; stay on the built path to protect mire vegetation.

facilities.name: Kolbotten north of Långmossen
facilities.description: Approximate official tent option at a charcoal base about 100 m north of Långmossen; model as low-impact heritage/tent context rather than a managed campsite, and improve the pin if better field data appears.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja remains
facilities.description: Approximate unusually well-preserved charcoal hut remains with burnt fireplace stones. Treat as protected heritage and do not disturb.

facilities.name: Finnsjön east wet crossings
facilities.description: Approximate drainage-creek zone from the bogs east of Finnsjön; spring melt and rain can make crossings high or wet.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Shelter at the stage 17/18 boundary, confirmed by shelter/map sources. Shared, first-come, and no guaranteed firewood. Official comments and 2024 reports describe the shelter/toilet as well kept, but one 2024 overnight report mentioned rodents/gnawing, so secure food and scented items.

facilities.name: Finnsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at the Finnsjön shelter based on Sörmlandsleden general shelter guidance and hiker reports. Use only when current fire rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Finnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Finnsjön, but not right beside the shelter; official text confirms a toilet at the endpoint and hiker reports describe it as a bit away from the shelter.

facilities.name: Finnsjön trash-bin context
facilities.description: Stage-specific official text and OSM indicate bins/waste context near Finnsjön, but verify in the field and be prepared to pack out trash.

facilities.name: Finnsjön information map
facilities.description: Information/map and shared Stage 17/18 junction context by Finnsjön. Use this as the snapped stage boundary even if GPX linework ends a few metres away.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter point tent area
facilities.description: Officially suitable tent place on the point by the shelter. Hiker reports describe many flat spots; keep tents on durable ground and respect shared shelter users.

facilities.name: Finnsjön swimming and lake water
facilities.description: Swimming/lake access near the shelter, with best swimming described on the stage-18 side. This is not a staffed bathing site; use conservative cold-water/open-water judgment. Natural lake water only.

facilities.name: Dog-control season reminder
facilities.description: General Swedish rule context: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed. Use leash/control on the narrow trail, wetland boardwalks, and reserve-adjacent sections.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Finnsjön and Trullsjön are lake-water/access context only. Fishing is not part of allemansrätten; verify permits and local rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Finnsjön road barrier warning
facilities.description: Access warning, not an on-route Stage 17 facility: official Sörmlandsleden says Finnsjön cannot be reached by car and warns that the Kalkbro/Finnsjön barrier may be missing from Lantmäteriet-based maps. OSM node 834675266 is a relevant Stage 18 gate/barrier context about 1.7 km from Finnsjön; do not advise bypassing barriers or driving closed/private roads.
